data.locations: Kuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
data.jd: <p><span style="font-size:inherit;"><u><span style="font-weight:bolder;">About ADA</span></u></span></p><p>ADA is the Data and AI Experience Company. Present in 14 markets globally, we build intelligent experiences that power enterprise growth, spanning identity and authentication, personalization, commerce, and data & AI foundations; where every touchpoint earns trust, every interaction creates value, and every decision runs on real-time intelligence, so enterprises can stay ahead and deliver measurable outcomes. Our mission is to build the world's most intelligent growth platform for every client we serve. We work with over 1,500 global brands across CPG, Retail, Telco, BFSI, and Healthcare.</p><div style="color:rgb(0,0,0);font-size:medium;border-width:medium medium 1pt;border-style:none none solid;border-color:rgb(26,86,160);padding:0in 0in 4pt;"><h2 style="margin:16pt 0in 6pt;font-size:14pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif;color:rgb(26,86,160);border-width:medium;border-style:none;padding:0in;"><span style="font-size:12pt;">About the Role</span></h2></div><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin:0in 0in 6pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif;color:rgb(85,85,85);"><span style="font-size:10.5pt;">We are looking for a seasoned Senior Product Manager to join our team in Jakarta and lead the development of innovative, customer-centric products. In this role, you will own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, working cross-functionally with Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, and Commercial teams to deliver products that create measurable business and customer impact.</span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin:0in 0in 6pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif;color:rgb(85,85,85);"><span style="font-size:10.5pt;">You will be a key decision-maker, setting priorities in a fast-paced environment and navigating ambiguity with confidence. This is a high-visibility role with the opportunity to shape the future of our product portfolio in one of Southeast Asia's most dynamic markets.</span></p><div style="color:rgb(0,0,0);font-size:medium;border-width:medium medium 1pt;border-style:none none solid;border-color:rgb(26,86,160);padding:0in 0in 4pt;"><h2 style="margin:16pt 0in 6pt;font-size:14pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif;color:rgb(26,86,160);border-width:medium;border-style:none;padding:0in;"><span style="font-size:12pt;">Key Responsibilities</span></h2></div><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin:0in 0in 4pt 30pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif;color:rgb(85,85,85);text-indent:-15pt;"><span style="font-size:10.5pt;">•<span style="font-variant:normal;font-size:7pt;line-height:normal;">      </span></span><span style="font-weight:bolder;"><span style="font-size:10.5pt;color:rgb(26,26,46);">Product Strategy & Vision</span></span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin:0in 0in 3pt 52.5pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif;color:rgb(85,85,85);text-indent:-15pt;"><span style="font-size:10.5pt;">o<span style="font-variant:normal;font-size:7pt;line-height:normal;">     </span></span><span style="font-size:10pt;">Define and own the product vision, strategy, and multi-quarter roadmap aligned with company objectives and market opportunities.</span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin:0in 0in 3pt 52.5pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif;color:rgb(85,85,85);text-indent:-15pt;"><span style="font-size:10.5pt;">o<span style="font-variant:normal;font-size:7pt;line-height:normal;">     </span></span><span style="font-size:10pt;">Identify unmet customer needs through primary research, data analysis, and competitive intelligence to inform product direction.</span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin:0in 0in 4pt 30pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif;color:rgb(85,85,85);text-indent:-15pt;"><span style="font-size:10.5pt;">•<span style="font-variant:normal;font-size:7pt;line-height:normal;">      </span></span><span style="font-weight:bolder;"><span style="font-size:10.5pt;color:rgb(26,26,46);">Roadmap Planning & Execution</span></span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin:0in 0in 3pt 52.5pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif;color:rgb(85,85,85);text-indent:-15pt;"><span style="font-size:10.5pt;">o<span style="font-variant:normal;font-size:7pt;line-height:normal;">     </span></span><span style="font-size:10pt;">Translate strategy into a clearly prioritized backlog; define OKRs, KPIs, and success metrics for each initiative.</span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin:0in 0in 3pt 52.5pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif;color:rgb(85,85,85);text-indent:-15pt;"><span style="font-size:10.5pt;">o<span style="font-variant:normal;font-size:7pt;line-height:normal;">     </span></span><span style="font-size:10pt;">Drive execution across the full product lifecycle — from discovery and ideation through development, launch, and iteration.</span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin:0in 0in 3pt 52.5pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif;color:rgb(85,85,85);text-indent:-15pt;"><span style="font-size:10.5pt;">o<span style="font-variant:normal;font-size:7pt;line-height:normal;">     </span></span><span style="font-size:10pt;">Make data-driven trade-off decisions on scope, timeline, and resources while managing stakeholder expectations.</span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin:0in 0in 4pt 30pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif;color:rgb(85,85,85);text-indent:-15pt;"><span style="font-size:10.5pt;">•<span style="font-variant:normal;font-size:7pt;line-height:normal;">      </span></span><span style="font-weight:bolder;"><span style="font-size:10.5pt;color:rgb(26,26,46);">Cross-functional Leadership</span></span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin:0in 0in 3pt 52.5pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif;color:rgb(85,85,85);text-indent:-15pt;"><span style="font-size:10.5pt;">o<span style="font-variant:normal;font-size:7pt;line-height:normal;">     </span></span><span style="font-size:10pt;">Act as the connective tissue across Engineering, Design, Data, Sales, Marketing, and Operations to align on priorities and resolve impediments.</span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin:0in 0in 3pt 52.5pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif;color:rgb(85,85,85);text-indent:-15pt;"><span style="font-size:10.5pt;">o<span criteria.</span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin:0in 0in 4pt 30pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif;color:rgb(85,85,85);text-indent:-15pt;"><span sans-serif;color:rgb(85,85,85);text-indent:-15pt;"><span style="font-size:10.5pt;">o<span style="font-variant:normal;font-size:7pt;line-height:normal;">     </span></span><span style="font-size:10pt;">Conduct user interviews, usability tests, and market research to develop deep empathy for target users and personas.</span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin:0in 0in 3pt 52.5pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif;color:rgb(85,85,85);text-indent:-15pt;"><span style="font-size:10.5pt;">o<span Southeast Asian market.</span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin:0in 0in 4pt 30pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif;color:rgb(85,85,85);text-indent:-15pt;"><span Management</span></span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin:0in 0in 3pt 52.5pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif;color:rgb(85,85,85);text-indent:-15pt;"><span sans-serif;color:rgb(85,85,85);text-indent:-15pt;"><span style="font-size:10.5pt;">•<span style="font-variant:normal;font-size:7pt;line-height:normal;">      </span></span><span style="font-size:10.5pt;">Qualification: Bachelor’s/Master’s degree; MBA is a plus.</span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin:0in 0in 4pt 30pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial, intelligent automation.</span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin:0in 0in 4pt 30pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif;color:rgb(85,85,85);text-indent:-15pt;"><span style="font-size:10.5pt;">•<span style="font-variant:normal;font-size:7pt;line-height:normal;">      </span></span><span style="font-size:10.5pt;">Demonstrated track record of owning and shipping impactful B2B or B2C products at scale.</span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin:0in 0in 4pt 30pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif;color:rgb(85,85,85);text-indent:-15pt;"><span style="font-size:10.5pt;">•<span style="font-variant:normal;font-size:7pt;line-height:normal;">      </span></span><span style="font-size:10.5pt;">Strong analytical skills; proficiency in data analysis and product analytics frameworks.</span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin:0in 0in 4pt 30pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,
